title: Specialist-review lapse - configured escalation fires, then unresolved escalated authority expires
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `specialist-review-expiration` (the configured escalation fires at P1D, then unresolved escalated authority reaches its projected expiry; exercises [proceed, awaiting-approval] and never reaches execution). Beyond the prompt-2 twelve (demo-contract §5 branch).

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Captain approved the explicit evidence-completeness matrix, canonical UTC timestamps, and the ordered ApprovalStageEscalated then ApprovalStageExpired correction on 2026-07-28. The original stage remains immutable; no approval is invalidated and no decision is derived solely from lapse.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request with a recently changed bank instruction (as in GC-03). The bank-change specialist takes no action; the P1D escalation fires first, then the unresolved escalated authority reaches its projected deadline.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD; specialist review lapses unactioned and escalates (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Destination bank instruction changed 2026-07-22, unverified - triggers Firm A's specialist-review handling.
Available taxable liquidity is 420000 USD with the reserve satisfied; authority progress is the only open question.
Recurring planned withdrawals 8000 USD/month; 6 months of reserve = 48000 USD (firm-a requirement).
No active pending or reserved liquidity activity was observed at evaluation time.
The destination restriction permits this request's household-titled destination.

householdInstructions.summary: Destination on-list (the changed instruction remains household-titled); satisfied.

expectedAuthority.note: Same required stages as GC-03. This case's subject is the time dimension: the P1D escalation step first projects operations-manager eligibility and a new expiry. When that authority remains unsatisfied through the projected deadline, expiration is recorded. The original stage is immutable and stage 2 never arms.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: Authority is unresolved: the escalation fired and its projected authority then expired unsatisfied. A proceed decision without completed authority is not executable; lapse never auto-approves.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: Firm A routes the recent bank-instruction change to a bank-change specialist (stage 1 of 2).

At P1D the configured escalation projected operations-manager eligibility and a new expiry; the unresolved authority later reached that deadline. Both facts are visible, the original stage is immutable, and nothing auto-approved.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: Bank-instruction change and evaluation snapshots pinned into the bundle.
Proceed decision requiring specialist review (stage 1) then dual approval (stage 2); the stage instance's expiresAt is computed and recorded at instantiation.
At P1D the configured escalation step fires, adding the operations-manager role and recording its projected expiry; the original stage remains immutable.
The projected escalated authority remains unsatisfied through its deadline, so the unresolved stage expiration is recorded without invalidating an approval or deriving a new decision.

expectedVerificationState.note: No execution occurs while authority is unresolved. The demo shows expiration and escalation as first-class, honest states (demo-contract §3, 2:30-3:20: expiration and escalation are visible proof).
